overview: The board voted to recommend City Council approval of a special permit for a Bank of America drive-thru ATM at 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway with conditions. The board also endorsed an Approval Not Required plan to combine lots at 26 Bradley Road and approved meeting minutes.

items.title: Special permit drive-thru use: 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: The board voted to recommend that the City Council approve a special permit for a Bank of America drive-thru ATM at the Meadow Glen Mall parking lot, subject to staff conditions including electric vehicle charging infrastructure.

items.title: Approval Not Required plan: 26 Bradley Road
items.summary: The board voted to affirm and endorse an Approval Not Required plan combining two existing lots into a single parcel.

items.title: Approval of minutes
items.summary: The board approved draft meeting minutes from September 6, 2023, and September 20, 2023.

items.title: Staff updates
items.summary: Staff briefed the board on upcoming project filings and announced open staff recruitments in the planning department.
